model: SK 540E / SK 545E frequency inverter (built-in Modbus RTU)
applies_to: NORD SK 500E-series inverters from SK 540E up (SK 540E, SK 545E) on the RS485 interface, per supplementary manual BU 0050 (GB-3111).
summary: NORD's SK 540E/545E inverters answer Modbus RTU on the same RS485 interface as USS, switching protocol automatically. Every parameter is reached at (parameter number x 64 + array index), so the hidden process-data arrays P050 (control word and setpoints) and P051 (status word and actual values) give the cyclic control block. This map covers that process data and the bus setup parameters.

addressing.note: The start address is the parameter number in bits 6-15 and the array index (or parameter set) in bits 0-5, sent as-is: P102 parameter set 1 = 0x1980, set 2 = 0x1981; P510 array element 2 = 0x7F81. The manual's examples read P051 from 0x0CC0 (status word + 3 actual values) and write setpoints 1-3 from 0x0C81. Registers here use index 0 (first element / parameter set 1).

source.title: BU 0050 USS Bus modules and MODBUS RTU - Supplementary manual for NORD frequency inverters
source.pages: 1.5.3.3-1.5.3.6 STW/ZSW bits and setpoint/actual value scaling pp. 30-34; 1.8 P509-P513 pp. 52-53; 2 Modbus RTU pp. 61-70 (features, function codes and frame examples, watchdog, coil list, process data P050/P051, parameter address model)

notes: This manual offers Modbus RTU only on SK 540E and SK 545E; the other series it covers (SK 300E, rest of SK 500E, SK 700E/750E) use USS on this interface.

Each 16-bit parameter is one address; read normally takes one parameter per request, except P050/P051 whose four elements can be read or written together. 32-bit parameters must be written with function 16; the manual's example writes P613 = 0x00123456 as 00 12 then 34 56, i.e. high word first.
Setpoints and actual values are relative: 16384 (0x4000) = 100 %, 0xC000 = -100 %, range about +/-200 %; setpoint 100 % = P105 maximum frequency of the active parameter set. They are kept raw.
Bus I/O coils 0x0000-0x0007 (Bus IO In 1-8, R/W) and 0x0008-0x000F (Bus IO Out 1-8, R) work only when P480/P481 assign them and P509/P510 are set to control terminals; they are not listed.
Left out: P513 telegram timeout (the manual gives 0.1 s steps on the keypad but no bus scaling), P543-P548 function lists, and fault parameters P700/P701 (array format not described in this manual).

bits.4: 1 = enable ramp generator (0 = ramp to zero)

registers.name: Process data IN: setpoint 1
registers.description: Default setpoint frequency: 16384 = 100 % of P105 max frequency.

integration.summary: Set P509 = 2 and P510[-01] = 2, P512 to 1 or 3-30, P511 to 38400 or less, then write 0x047E and next 0x047F to P050[-01] (0x0C80) with setpoint 1 at 0x0C81 (16384 = P105). Poll 0x0CC0-0x0CC3 for status word and actual values.
integration.enable: Set P509 = 2 (USS control word; Modbus is detected automatically on SK 540E+) and P510[-01] = 2 for the setpoint. Set P512 to 1 or 3-30 (factory 0 is the broadcast address, and address 2 must not be used: it stops the automatic switch to Modbus) and P511 baud (Modbus max 38400). The format is fixed at 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit.
integration.watchdog: P513 telegram downtime: monitoring starts with the first valid telegram; if no new telegram arrives in time the inverter trips with E010 (error 10.0 Bus Time Out). 0.0 = off (factory); -0.1 = no error even if communication is lost.
quirks: Addresses are parameter x 64 + index, not the parameter number: P509 = 32576.
Control word follows the USS/PROFIdrive pattern: 0x047E = ready for switch-on, then set bit 0 (0x047F) to run; bit 10 must be 1 or the process data is ignored.
Address 2 disables Modbus (the port stays USS).
setup: Connect RS485 on terminals X7:73/74 (SK 520E and above) or the RJ12 socket X11; switch on the termination with DIP 1 at the bus ends.
Up to 32 devices per RS485 segment; RS232 only for point-to-point.
gotchas: Baud rates above 38400 exist in P511 but are not valid for Modbus.
If a digital input is set for fault acknowledge, do not hold control-word bit 7 at 1 from the bus, or the edge detection stops working.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
